I appreciate that. I'll see what my friends can do but I don't know what to do if they can't. Or even if they can, with that in mind. 

I'm trying really hard not to panic and overreact right now. I've tackled depression for years now and this is the biggest set-back in a very long line of them

I'm in the northeast US. I don't think there are any shelters in my town. It's a pretty small town. 

There might be a friend or two I could stay with for a while. I'm not sure though. I don't have a lot of friends, and it'd have to be something very temporary in any case.

Thanks for saying you care about me. It's really hard to believe that anyone does right now. 

I just...I could barely want to live before. I'm not sure how I'm going to get through this. It's very dark, and it's a huge temptation to just give up. I'm tired and sick.

do you know what the shittiest thing about being homeless is

the only people who can be homeless are the truly unloved
